I trusted my flatmate with my mental health struggles and told him about my supplementary exam in Operating Systems because I thought he was my safe space. I spent the last three weeks building the entire backend for our Capstone project while my group mates did absolutely nothing but play games. My roommate was the only person who knew how terrified I am about failing my midterms and how my dad threatens to stop paying my semester fees if my GPA drops. Everyone is whispering when I walk into the lecture hall now. I feel so naked and betrayed by the one person I thought had my back.

We have been a study circle since first semester, sharing every single PDF, resource, and test prep. My best friend and I promised we would crack the same tech company so we could move to Bangalore together. They didn't even apologize, just said 'it's business.' I lost my dream job and my best friend in the same afternoon.

My roommate and I spent three weeks building our final year project. I did all the backend work, literally pulled three all-nighters debugging the APIs while he just made the UI. He blocked me on GitHub and is acting like he did it all himself in our wing group chats. I feel so sick to my stomach, like I'm completely invisible and stupid for trusting him.

I can’t even focus on the next round of mass recruitments because my chest literally hurts and I feel discarded like trash.

I can't sleep, my heart is racing, and I don't know how to prove my innocence when the system just believes whatever is reported.

I sacrificed my dream of going to an out-of-state college and took a local college with a high backlog history just so my younger brother could afford coaching for IIT-JEE. I feel completely betrayed, abandoned, and terrified about my future.

How do you just erase someone who trusted you with their life and career?
